Job Description: Title: Assistant Trainee Company: Metso Location: Helsinki Region, Finland URL: https://fi.linkedin.com/jobs/view/assistant-trainee-at-metso-4423956248 Posted: 2026-06-05 Deadline: Open until filled Reason: The role is an administrative assistant trainee position, but requires a university degree which may disqualify Manju based on her education. ======================================== JOB DESCRIPTION: ======================================== LinkedIn respects your privacy LinkedIn and 3rd parties use essential and non-essential cookies to provide, secure, analyze and improve our Services, and to show you relevant ads (including professional and job ads) on and off LinkedIn. Learn more in our Cookie Policy. Select Accept to consent or Reject to decline non-essential cookies for this use. You can update your choices at any time in your settings. Accept Reject Skip to main content LinkedIn Jobs Clear text Clear text Sign in Join now Assistant Trainee Metso Espoo, Uusimaa, Finland 3 weeks ago Over 200 applicants See who Metso has hired for this role Use AI to assess how you fit Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features. Am I a good fit for this job? Tailor my resume Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life. Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources. Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration. This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible. Introduction We are seeking a Trainee for the Legal team to support the Legal Executive Assistant in various administrative tasks, as well as to assist the Corporate Legal team with corporate legal and subsidiary governance related work. You will help to ensure that the team members have the best possible practical arrangements and conditions to focus on their areas of responsibility. You will report to the Legal Executive Assistant. The contract is approximately 6 months and, depending on the chosen trainee, is either part-time or full-time or a mixture of both. Our wish is that the trainee would start as soon as possible or in August at the latest. As an Assistant Trainee, your daily tasks will consist of: Supporting in subsidiary governance document management Maintaining the Corporate Governance database and providing reports Scheduling and organizing team’s face-to-face and virtual meetings, events, workshops, and trainings Assisting with invoice handling, cost follow-up and travel management Assisting with document management and information sharing (updating intranet, corporate registers, etc.) Assisting other Legal and Compliance team members when needed Who you are: A service-minded and positive can-do attitude, with willingness to help others Great teamworking skills while also ability to work independently High level of integrity with the ability to handle confidential information Good organizational skills and ability to multitask Willingness to work in a quickly changing atmosphere, with tolerance for changing plans and time pressure Ability to see the big picture without losing attention to detail Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Finnish and English Good command of Microsoft Office tools Willingness to learn new skills and share knowledge Flexibility in working hours when needed What's in it for you: This is an exciting opportunity for you who would like to work in a truly international business environment. If you enjoy being able to make things run smoothly even in rapidly changing situations, this is a chance for you to show your abilities while learning about the business. In this role, you work closely with the global Legal and Compliance team and other stakeholders. We offer benefits, such as healthcare, Epass Flex, Auntie mental well-being service, flexible working times, buddy support, learning opportunities, and networking and social activities in all our locations throughout the summer. The expected monthly salary for our full-time trainee roles is between 2130-2970 euros per month. The exact monthly salary for each role is based on the candidate's number of completed academic credits and job location. Get in touch Want to rise above the possible with us? Click ‘Apply now’ to leave your resume and cover letter. Please include in your cover letter when you would be able to start and whether you would prefer to work part-time or full-time. The position will be filled as soon as we find a suitable candidate. For additional information, please contact Tiina Torp (Executive Assistant, Legal and Compliance) by email at tiina.torp(at)metso.com or call (+358 40 546 2238) during the available timeslots: Friday, June 5, between 12-14, Monday, June 8, between 13-15 and Thursday, June 11, between 13-15 Finnish time. Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices. How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability. Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change. Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. paragraphs: Olen kirjoittanut tämän hakemuksen Assistant Trainee -paikkaan Metson joukossa. Mahdollisuus työskennellä kansainvälisen sopimuslainsäädännön, IP:n ja tietosuoja-asetusten parissa maailmanlaajuisessa yrityksessä on juuri sellainen ympäristö, johon olen toistuvasti pyrkinyt. Minulla on vahvuus soveltaa kansainvälistä lainsäädännön osaamistaan ja aktiivista työskentelyasennetta Metson joukossa.

Oma LL.M.-diplomi liike- ja yhtiöoikeudesta (Symbiosis International University, 1. sija) sekä käytännön kokemus sopimusdokumenttien laatimisesta ja neuvottelusta yrityksen oikeudellisessa toiminnassa on antanut minulle vankan pohjan työskennellä Metson sisällä.

Tällä hetkellä suoritan OPH-tuntemaan lisäopintoihin Suomen lain tarkastukseen Laplandin yliopistossa, mikä osoittaa sitoutumistaan integroitua kansainvälinen osaamiseni ja suomalaiseen lainsäädäntöön. Tykkään sekä monimutkaisesta oikeudellisesta analyysistä että järkevistä hallinnollisista tehtävistä samalla tavalla.

Metso on sisäpiirteinen malli, joka tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä yhtiön oikeudellisen osaston kanssa ja saada kokemusta yrityksen tason oikeudellisesta toiminnasta. Olen saatavilla syyskuussa 2026 ja voin sitoutua osittaisesti akateemisen vuoden aikana, siirtyen täysipainoiselle kevät- ja syksyllä.
Haluaisin keskustella siitä, miten voisin auttaa teijän joukossa.
